title: Ribbon totals: Peak ticket
summary: Produce the running totals of the readings, including the current reading at each position. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.
descriptionMd:
A spool of adding-machine tape runs from the morning account to the afternoon balance. Alma is setting the upper stop on an old office gauge. The largest derived reading goes on its label, even if the whole tray is below zero.

Produce the running totals of the readings, including the current reading at each position.

Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative.

Implement ribbonTotalsPeakTicket(readings, k). k is part of the common inspection-card signature and does not affect this task's result.
unitIntro: Loop accumulators. Produce the running totals of the readings, including the current reading at each position. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys (earlier units are used while the first two levels establish the foundations).
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with loop accumulators. What state describes the portion you have already processed?
Produce the running totals of the readings, including the current reading at each position. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.

cases.explanation: The derived sequence is [7,4,11,11,23]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 23.
The derived sequence is [4,8,6,10]. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 10.
The derived sequence is []. Return the largest value in the derived sequence, or 0 for an empty sequence. Negative maxima must remain negative. This gives 0.
